title: HS50034: Environmental Policy
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Prerequisites: HS30072Course ContentsExternalities and Public Goods; Coase
Theorem Vs. Pigouvian Solution, Pigouvian Taxes and Subsidies, Tradable
Permits: Price Vs. Quantity Instruments, Mixed Instruments; Enforcement Issues;
Environmental Regulation in India: Evolution of Environmental Policy in India;
Air and Water Acts; Fiscal Incentives; Enforcement and Implementation Issues,
Case Studies on Pollution Control in India and other Countries; Capital Theory
Framework with Uncertainty, Risk and Irreversibility, Inter-temporal
Efficiency, Intergenerational Equity; Distributive Issues: Intra and
Intergenerational Equity, Poor and the Environment, Gender Issues and Access to
Environmental Resources and Environmental Movements, Political Economy of
Development; International Environmental Problems: Transboundary Pollution,
Causes and Consequences of Ozone Depletion, Acid Rains, Global Warming, Rio
Conference (Agenda 21); Protocols Relating to Climate Change; Trade and
Environment Interaction, Case Studies.
